Account Info Type Account Type Account Types Pick the type that best matches your account.\n\nAsset: Use for things like frequent flyer mileage or other assets that you want to track.\n\nCash: Use for cash types of accounts.\n\nLiabilities: Used for things like loans or accounts receivables.\n\nOnline: This is a special type of account. If you set the account type to Online, then set the website to your bank or credit card online banking website. PocketMoney doesn\t support real online banking, but by entering your online banking accounts in PocketMoney it will let you keep all the accounts together. Instead of going to the list of transactions in PocketMoney when you tap on the account name like other account types, PocketMoney will open the website you enter so that you can log in. This is similar to how the current Bank of America application on AppStore works. It shows you a quick overview of all your worth.\n\nLong pressing an account lets you edit account details and delete the account.\n\nThe Preference menu button contains help, video tutorials, and settings such as password protection.\n\nThe View-Options menu button contains options for what accounts or the type of balance to display. Welcome back Your first account is on the Accounts screen.\n\nThe checkbox on the far left includes the account in Total Worth. This calculates the balance at the bottom.\n\nTap Edit to return to Account Info.\n\nTap the account name to view its transactions.\n\nTap plus (+) to add a transaction.\n\nLet\'s open your register. Tap %1$s. You can enter as much or as little information as you want. Only the Account name is required.\n\nUse Fee for charges like out-of-network ATM fees.\n\nLimit can be the credit limit for a credit card, or a minimum balance for a bank account. Type determines how Limit is handled.\n\nLastly, use the notes field for any other details you want to track. Repeating Transactions Tips PocketMoney can enter transactions for you that occur on a regular schedule.\n\nTo create bi-weekly repeating transactions set the frequency to weekly, and set Every to Every 2 Week(s).\n\nTransactions that happen quarterly have a frequency of Monthly, and Every set to Every 3 Months(s). About Budgets Budgeting can help you plan and control your spending.\n\nThe Edit button lets you edit budget category details and delete categories.\n\nGo ahead and press the \'Edit\' button to list all the budget categories. Tapping on a category from the Edit screen will open an editor screen for the category so you can set your budget limit. Set as many budget limits as you wish to track. Tap Done and the Budgets screen will show all the categories you are tracking budgets for. If a category has transactions associated with it, tapping on the category line will open a transaction register showing all transactions for that category.\n\nThe Balance/Available/Budgeted column heading can be tapped to change what is displayed - balance is the amount you are over or under budget; available is the amount under budget you are, if you are over budget it shows zero available; budgeted is the amount budgeted in that category. Red Badge When an account exceeds/drops below the Limit set in Account Info, then the balance will display in red and a red badge will appear on the PocketMoney icon on your Home screen showing the number of accounts below/above their limits. Tap Edit to create and manage your accounts. Tap + to create a new account. Here are a few tips to help you get started.\n\nPocketMoney organizes transactions into three basic types:\n\nWithdrawal: Spending money (e.g. shopping, fuel, paying bills).\n\nDeposit: Receiving money (e.g. salary, refunds).\n\nTransfer: Moving money between two of your accounts.\n\nOpening balances: Use Deposit for Bank, Cash, and Asset accounts. Use Withdrawal for Credit Card and Liability accounts.\n\nOnly the amount is needed, though entering a Payee and Category helps with charts and reports.\n\nUse Class to further categorize expenses.\n\n+Fee adds a transaction using the fee saved in Account Info. Account View Options Choose All unless you manage many accounts.\n\nNon-Zero shows only accounts with an active balance.\n\nTotal Worth shows only checked accounts.\n\nYou can also choose which balance appears in the bottom bar:\n\nCurrent Balance is the default total balance.\n\nCleared Balance includes only reconciled transactions that have cleared your bank.\n\nCurrent Balance (Now) excludes future-dated transactions such as upcoming bills.\n\nAvailable Credit shows remaining credit for credit card and credit line accounts. Report tips Did I really spend that much on X?\n\nReports give you a handy way to analyze what you\'ve spent money on. The report defaults to a list view. Anything checked will be included in the Expenses total and included in the pie chart.\n\nIf you want to a break-down of an expense line, press it, and it will show you a list of transactions.\n\nA very handy trick is to choose a Category Report, pick an expense for example Food, then look at the Payee Report based on Food to show you a break-down of where you spent your money on Food.
